bundle.shortDescription: Aim trainer for VALORANT that finds what is wrong with your aim and checks whether practice fixed it
bundle.longDescription: AimForge measures how you aim (reaction, first movement, correction, click), turns it into a short training plan, and retests you with an equivalent test to show whether the trained skills really improved.
